name: promptless
description: Promptless monorepo — NestJS + tRPC backend with shared packages

scripts.build: npm run build -w @promptless/core && npm run build -w @promptless/ai && npm run build -w @promptless/perception && npm run build -w @promptless/memory && npm run build -w @promptless/integrations && npm run build -w @promptless/api
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @promptless/core && npm run build -w @promptless/ai && npm run build -w @promptless/api
